{"notes": "Visit 4 (6:00). Final state: the picture shows every domino dark, so everything is connected to the start. The body, nose curl, bottom line, upper tail lobe and a new lower tail lobe (bottom line out to about x=28.5, y=16.5) are all in place. Nothing is pale or stranded. The tail is open, but the whole run should fall. I still haven't seen anyone place a domino, so I'm rating on results and on what people said.

Maya: Her upper lobe was connected, and she did final checks on the top lobe and the start join. Staying hands-off at the end was sensible. Set the direction with the fish idea. Execution solid, leadership good. Impact good.

Tom: Delivered the bottom line and handed off to Leo cleanly. At 5:00 he called the run connected and asked Leo to shout when the lobe was down, which kept coordination tight. The earlier talk-over-build pattern and late start are now outweighed by the result. Collaboration strong, impact good.

Priya: Status updates were accurate and the nose joint check held up. Staying hands-off at the end was prudent. I never saw her build directly, and I still need to ask about her sketch and what she built. I'm holding her ratings provisional, at solid but unproven.

Leo: My earlier concern is mostly resolved. The lower lobe went up after the 3:45 handoff, was reported at 5:15, and the picture confirms it is connected. His idle time looks dependency-driven rather than reluctance. Still ask him privately what he built and whether he could have started sooner. Execution good, collaboration good (clear report, kept checking the join).

Team: Everyone finished on time with a clean connection. Check in the review whether anyone helped Leo while he was waiting."}
